user.title: Connect SAX Power Home
user.description: Enter the IP address of your SAX Power Home (Plus). The remaining values are preset for a standard Modbus TCP connection. Once connected, you can optionally configure grid charging and the dashboard.

reconfigure.title: Change SAX Power Home connection
reconfigure.description: Update the IP address or other connection details of the SAX Power Home (Plus) storage system. The integration reloads automatically with the new values after saving.

grid_charge.title: Grid charging (optional)
grid_charge.description:
Optionally set up classic grid charging now: it charges within the time window from the lower to the upper SOC limit. Leave it disabled if you prefer to set up charging in the dashboard later.

Set up demand-based night control and price-optimised charging under Configure after completing setup.

dashboard.title: Dashboard (optional)
dashboard.description: Optionally enable the “SAX Power” dashboard with general information, time-of-use tariff, dynamic tariff, grid-serving charging and savings.

data_description.vue_dashboard_enabled: Adds “SAX Power” to the sidebar with sensor values, charging controls and savings.

finish.title: Setup complete

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the SAX storage system. Check the IP address and port, and that the storage system is reachable on the network.
error.invalid_response: Connected to the storage system, but it replied with a Modbus error. Check the slave ID (Basic Mode).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one SAX storage system can currently be configured. To change the existing storage system, please use "Reconfigure".
abort.reconfigure_successful: The connection details have been updated.

state.discharge_blocked: Discharge stopped due to grid charging

price_charge_max_price.name: Grid draw and charging up to

price_charge_neutral_price.name: Grid draw without charging up to

extended_mode_unavailable.title: SAX SunSpec mode unreachable
extended_mode_unavailable.description: The SunSpec mode register block (slave ID {slave_id}) of the SAX storage system is unreachable. Sensors that depend on it (storage detail values, grid/smart meter values, battery values) show "unknown" until the connection is restored. Basic Mode sensors (state of charge, switch, power limits) are not affected. Please check whether the configured slave ID (SunSpec mode, default: 100) is correct and whether the device runs firmware combination Master V61/Gateway V54 or newer.

price_charge_conflict.title: Price-optimised charging and grid charging both active

init.title: Turn off grid charging for price-optimised charging?
init.description:
Price-optimised charging was switched on while grid charging (timed charging) is active. Both charge actively from the grid through the same write path and cannot run at the same time.

**Confirm**: Grid charging is turned off and price-optimised charging is activated.
**Cancel**: Nothing changes, price-optimised charging stays off.

timed_charge_conflict.title: Grid charging and price-optimised charging both active

init.title: Turn off price-optimised charging for grid charging?
init.description:
Grid charging (timed charging) was switched on while price-optimised charging is active. Both charge actively from the grid through the same write path and cannot run at the same time.

**Confirm**: Price-optimised charging is turned off and grid charging is activated.
**Cancel**: Nothing changes, grid charging stays off.

price_sensor_missing.title: Price-optimised charging: price sensor delivers no data
price_sensor_missing.description: Price-optimised charging is active, but the price sensor {price_sensor} has delivered no usable price data for over 6 hours (entity no longer exists, no price forecast, or wrong attribute). No grid charging is happening at the moment. Please check the price sensor under "Configure" on this integration.

economics_price_unavailable.title: Economics: import price unavailable
economics_price_unavailable.description: No valid import price has been available for the economics evaluation for over 6 hours - for a fixed or time-of-use tariff this can also be an immediate configuration error (a missing required price, a broken time-window group). New charge energy is booked as unpriced in the meantime and never re-evaluated retroactively. Please check the import price tariff, or for a dynamic tariff the selected electricity price sensor, under "Configure" on this integration.

sunspec_persistently_unavailable.title: SAX SunSpec mode persistently unreachable
sunspec_persistently_unavailable.description: Slave ID {slave_id} has been continuously unreachable for over an hour. Storage detail values, grid/smart meter values and all three charging automations (timed, grid-serving and price-optimised charging) are non-functional without this register block. Please check the network connection and the configured slave ID (SunSpec mode, default: 100).

max_soc_below_min_soc.title: Grid charge max. SOC is below min. SOC
max_soc_below_min_soc.description: "Grid charge max. SOC" ({max_soc} %) is below "Grid charge min. SOC" ({min_soc} %). Timed charging stops before reaching its start threshold again, leaving no gap between the start and stop thresholds. Please raise grid charge max. SOC or lower grid charge min. SOC.

empty_charge_window.title: Time window is empty or incomplete
empty_charge_window.description: The time window for "{feature}" is empty or incomplete (start and end time are identical or missing) - the automation therefore never runs. Please set a start and end time with different values.

no_active_months.title: No month selected
no_active_months.description: No month at all is enabled for "{feature}" - the feature is therefore inactive all year round. Please enable at least one month.

price_neutral_below_limit.title: Neutral price is not above the price limit
price_neutral_below_limit.description: "Neutral price" ({neutral_price} EUR/kWh) is not above "Price limit" ({max_price} EUR/kWh) - the pause zone of price-optimised charging (charging and discharging stopped between these two values) can therefore never engage, the storage behaves outside of charging phases as it did before the neutral price was introduced. Please raise the neutral price above the price limit.

control_config_unreadable.title: Charging settings could not be read
control_config_unreadable.description: The stored software-side charging settings (max. SOC, time windows, automations, price parameters) could not be read on startup. Safe defaults apply temporarily (automations off, max. SOC 100%); changes are only effective in memory until this integration is reloaded and are NOT saved, to avoid overwriting the existing data. Please check the cause (e.g. disk space, Home Assistant file permissions) and then reload the integration under Settings -> Devices & Services.

control_config_unresolved.title: Some charging settings could not be restored automatically
control_config_unresolved.description: The following settings had a value that could not be evaluated (unknown/unavailable) on the first start of this version and were therefore set to their safe default instead of the previous value: {fields}. Please review these settings and set them again as desired - this notice disappears automatically once resolved.

vue_dashboard_update.title: Update the dashboard and reload it in your browser

init.title: Update the dashboard
init.description:
A different version is available for the enabled dashboard, an earlier version has not been acknowledged yet, or the panel could not be registered.

This repair registers the dashboard again using the bundled version. Charging settings are preserved. Afterwards, every open browser needs a full reload to use the new interface.

**Later** dismisses this version only. A subsequent version change will be reported again.

confirm.title: Retry the dashboard update
confirm.description: Registration has not succeeded yet. Check the Home Assistant log and try again. If the integration has been updated in the meantime, close this dialog and open the current repair issue.

reload.title: dashboard registered – reload your browser
reload.description:
The dashboard has been registered using the current bundled version. Complete this step, then **fully reload every open Home Assistant page** (browser: reload the page; Companion app: reload the frontend). Switching dashboard tabs is not enough.

Your browser will then use the new interface.

error.update_failed: The dashboard could not be updated. The issue has not been marked as fixed.

abort.no_longer_available: The integration or enabled dashboard is no longer available.
abort.update_changed: The dashboard version or its availability has changed in the meantime. Open the current repair issue again; the new version was not acknowledged.

invalid_grid_charge_power.message: The power setpoint {power} is invalid. Safe manual grid charging requires an integer between {min_power} W and {max_power} W; zero and positive values are not supported.

economics_restart_not_ready.message: A balance restart is only possible while economics is enabled and already initialized.

start_grid_charge.name: Start grid charge
start_grid_charge.description: Requests manual grid charging through the central control path protected by the max SOC limit.

power.name: Power
power.description: Strictly negative setpoint for grid charging in watts (-32768 to -1 W).

stop_grid_charge.name: Stop grid charge
stop_grid_charge.description: Stops the manual charging request and makes a best-effort return to SmartMeter control.

set_timed_charge_window.name: Set timed charge window
set_timed_charge_window.description: Sets the start and end time of the timed grid charge window atomically in a single call, instead of using the individual start/end time entities.

set_grid_serving_window.name: Set grid-serving charge window
set_grid_serving_window.description: Sets the start and end time of the grid-serving charge window atomically in a single call, instead of using the individual start/end time entities.

refresh_price_plan.name: Recalculate charge plan
refresh_price_plan.description: Recalculates and applies the price-optimised charging plan immediately. Demand-based night control normally evaluates every five minutes; other strategies check every 60 seconds.

set_price_charge_enabled.name: Switch price-optimised charging
set_price_charge_enabled.description: Turns price-optimised charging on or off. If grid charging blocks activation the call fails - with “force” it is turned off without asking instead.

enabled.name: Active
enabled.description: Turn price-optimised charging on or off.

force.name: Force
force.description: Turns off an active grid charging without asking.

restart_economics_accounting.name: Restart economics accounting
restart_economics_accounting.description: Deliberately resets the economics balance (money sums, net savings, price-coverage counters, day buckets and activation time) - never touches energy counters or the charge-origin split.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Optional free text (120 characters max), diagnostic only.

init.title: Configure SAX Power
init.description:
Choose the area you want to change. Each area is saved separately; other settings are preserved.

Set charging strategy, SOC limits, time windows and active months in the SAX Power dashboard or through the device entities.

menu_options.price: Electricity price for charging and economics
menu_options.pv: Solar forecast for Smart and grid-serving charging

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Enable direct access to readings, charging controls and savings from the Home Assistant sidebar.

data_description.vue_dashboard_enabled: Adds “SAX Power” to the sidebar with readings, charging controls and savings.

price.title: Electricity price source
price.description:
Choose the shared price source for price-optimised charging and a dynamic economics tariff. A sensor is not needed for a fixed-price or time-of-use evaluation alone.

A dynamic economics tariff requires this source. Manage the tariff model and fixed prices under Electricity tariff for economics.

data_description.price_sensor: Shared price source for price-optimised charging and economics with a dynamic tariff. Select a sensor with the current energy price. Relative, Smart and Night bridge also need its price forecast attributes.
data_description.price_attribute: Usually leave this empty: the price forecast is detected automatically. Specify an attribute only if needed, for example raw_today, data or forecast.
data_description.price_unit: Automatic uses the sensor’s unit. Set it here if that unit is missing or incorrect.

pv.title: Solar forecast for Smart and grid-serving charging
pv.description: This solar forecast is used by Smart and grid-serving charging. Demand-based night control has its own setup area for selecting the provider and installation.

data.pv_forecast_factor: Usable share of the PV forecast (%)

data_description.pv_forecast_sensor: Select a sensor with expected solar energy, such as tomorrow’s production from Forecast.Solar or Solcast. Smart and grid-serving charging share this source.
data_description.pv_forecast_factor: For Smart only: the share of forecast solar energy expected to reach the battery. A lower value accounts for household consumption, forecast uncertainty and losses. Grid-serving charging uses the unmodified sensor value.

hems.title: Night control: solar provider
hems.description:
Night control estimates the grid charging needed until solar power is available in the morning. It uses stored energy, past overnight SAX discharge and a solar forecast over time.

First choose the provider, then the installation and forecast settings. Afterwards, enable Demand-based or Demand-based / Night bridge in the dashboard.

data_description.hems_pv_provider: Choose the provider already configured in Home Assistant. Night control supports pv_forecast and Solcast. Forecast.Solar does not supply the freshness and quality information required here. Not configured removes the existing source assignment.

hems_source.title: Night control: solar installation
hems_source.description:
Choose the installation whose forecast should be used. The integration checks that the data is recent enough and covers the required period. For pv_forecast, the last successful retrieval must be no more than 60 minutes old.

Continue to the forecast settings. Changes are saved only at the end.

data_description.hems_pv_entry: Choose the complete installation. Only entries from the selected provider are offered. If none appear, first set up the provider’s integration in Home Assistant.
data_description.hems_solcast_timestamp: Usually leave this empty: the API Last Polled sensor is found automatically. A manually selected sensor must belong to this Solcast installation. Its value records when the forecast was last retrieved.
data_description.hems_solcast_max_age_hours: Maximum age of a verified Solcast retrieval: 1 to 24 hours, default 24. Forecasts that are older or have no verified retrieval time are not used for demand planning.

hems_settings.title: Night control: forecast and efficiencies
hems_settings.description:
The defaults are suitable for getting started. Open the groups to use forecast improvements or adjust the efficiencies.

New estimation methods affect charging only after validation. The estimate covers observable SAX discharge, not total household consumption. Saving also applies the provider and installation.

forecast.description: Observe first; use automatically once enough evidence is available.

data.hems_live_adjustment: Include the current night in comparisons

data_description.hems_archive_enabled: Stores forecasts locally and later compares them with measured SAX discharge. This is needed to validate and approve new estimation methods. Storage is limited in both age and size.
data_description.hems_history_days: History for the new night profile: 7 days by default or 28 days for a longer lookback. The existing seven-day forecast remains the reference until the new method is validated.
data_description.hems_forecast_mode: Observe evaluates new estimation methods without changing charging. Automatic after validation uses them only after a successful comparison with actual observations. The forecast archive must collect evidence for this.
data_description.hems_live_adjustment: Also evaluates SAX discharge over the past 45 minutes. The adjustment affects control only after validation together with the selected night profile. Changes to the profile or live adjustment require new validation.

forecast.name: Improve the forecast (optional)

efficiency.description: Assumptions for charge and discharge losses. Default: 0.95 = 95% each.

data_description.hems_charge_efficiency: Share of charging energy retained in the battery. 0.95 means 95%. Values greater than 0 and up to 1 are allowed; keep 0.95 if unsure.
data_description.hems_discharge_efficiency: Share of stored energy usable when discharging. 0.95 means 95%. Values greater than 0 and up to 1 are allowed; keep 0.95 if unsure.

efficiency.name: Efficiencies (advanced)

economics.title: Electricity tariff for economics
economics.description:
Choose how your electricity provider charges for grid imports. Enter the relevant prices in the next step. For a dynamic tariff, a missing price source is requested first.

This selection controls the financial balance. Set the charging strategy in the dashboard.

data_description.economics_tariff_type: Fixed price: one energy price all day. Time of use: a default price with up to eight daily recurring price windows. Dynamic: the current price from the shared electricity price sensor. Disabled: no economics evaluation.

amortization.title: Investment and prior earnings
amortization.description:
Enter your investment to see how much has already been recovered. For an older system, you can also enter earnings from before this integration was set up.

These values are preserved when changing tariffs.

data_description.economics_investment_cost_eur: Total purchase cost of the battery, installation and accessories. Used for payback progress, ROI and the remaining amount. Leave empty to disable these readings; the rest of the financial balance is preserved.
data_description.economics_prior_result_eur: Optional earnings from before this integration was set up. They count only towards payback and do not change measured net savings or their history. Leave empty or enter 0 for no prior earnings.

economics_fixed.title: Economics: fixed price
economics_fixed.description:
Enter your fixed electricity price and feed-in tariff.

Enter prices in EUR/kWh including taxes and levies. Exclude monthly standing charges, bonuses and other fixed costs.

data_description.economics_feed_in_price_eur_kwh: Payment you receive for exporting one kilowatt-hour. This forgone revenue is counted as a cost when solar energy is stored.
data_description.economics_fixed_import_price_eur_kwh: Required. Energy price for grid imports, constant all day.

economics_dynamic.title: Economics: dynamic tariff
economics_dynamic.description:
The grid import price comes from the shared electricity price source. Enter your feed-in tariff here.

Enter prices in EUR/kWh including taxes and levies. Exclude monthly standing charges, bonuses and other fixed costs.

data_description.economics_feed_in_price_eur_kwh: Payment you receive for exporting one kilowatt-hour. This forgone revenue is counted as a cost when solar energy is stored.

economics_time_of_use.title: Economics: time-of-use tariff
economics_time_of_use.description:
Set a default energy price and add up to eight windows with different prices. This schedule repeats daily and does not need a price sensor.

Windows may cross midnight and touch, but must not overlap. The start belongs to the window; the end does not. The Home Assistant time zone applies.

Enter prices in EUR/kWh including taxes and levies. Exclude monthly standing charges, bonuses and other fixed costs.

data_description.economics_feed_in_price_eur_kwh: Payment you receive for exporting one kilowatt-hour. This forgone revenue is counted as a cost when solar energy is stored.
data_description.economics_tou_base_price_eur_kwh: Required. Applies at all times outside the windows below.

economics_tou_window_1.description: Fill in all three fields or leave all three empty.

error.economics_price_sensor_required: The dynamic tariff needs the electricity price sensor selected above. Pick a sensor or choose another tariff model.
error.economics_tou_window_incomplete: A window is incomplete: start, end and energy price must all be filled in or all be empty.
error.economics_tou_window_zero_length: Start and end of a window must differ - an empty range is not a window and does not mean "all day".
error.economics_tou_window_overlap: Two windows overlap. Touching boundaries (end of one = start of the next) are allowed, overlapping ones are not.
error.economics_price_required: Required: please enter an energy price in EUR/kWh (gross price including all levies).
error.hems_pv_entry_invalid: The PV installation must belong to the selected provider. For an optional Solcast timestamp, select the enabled “API Last Polled” sensor from the same installation.
error.hems_invalid_number: Enter a finite number within the displayed range.
